note: K (`k`) — SMG / Attacker / Electric / Burst III (40s); ammo 120, reloadFrames 129, hitsPerShot 2, normalMult 9.1, coreMult 200, base crit 15%/critDmg 150%. A stack-and-dump burst DPS: she builds 'Tilted Scale' crit rate while firing her SMG, then her burst swaps to a slow 10-pellet electric shotgun for 10s. MODEL — BURST (dominant damage): self weaponSwap (damagePct 92.5, pelletCount 10, weapon 'SG', pullsPerSec 2.4, durationSec 10) + self ATK 63.36% of caster (casterAtkPct) for 10s + self Attack Damage 21.12% for 10s, all on burstCast. The kit's burst weapon is 'Damage 92.5% of final ATK, Pelletcount 10, Attack speed ▼90%, 10s'. The swap is a REAL shotgun: `weapon: 'SG'` routes her burst shots through the same SG accuracy-circle pellet-landing model and the same near-band-only range eligibility as any other SG-class weapon, and `pelletCount: 10` is that weapon's own pellet base for the landing/gauge path. `damagePct: 92.5` is the FULL-SHOT total with all 10 pellets landing — the same convention every SG-class unit's `normalAttackMultiplier` uses in this engine (each pellet carries 92.5/10 = 9.25% of final ATK), so the per-shot damage is 92.5% × (landed pellets / 10). CADENCE: the swap weapon's own nominal fire rate is 144 RPM — 10% of her base SMG's datamined `rate_of_fire` (1440 RPM), matching the kit's 'Attack speed ▼90%' applied to the RAW rate rather than to the already-frame-quantized 20.0/s effective SMG rate. Run through the engine's own frame-quantization formula (`quantizeToFrames`, src/engine/sim.ts:224, FPS/ceil(FPS/nominal)) that every weapon's nominal→effective cadence uses: 144 RPM = 2.4 pulls/s nominal, and 60/2.4 = 25 is already an exact frame count, so quantization is a no-op here (unlike the base SMG's own 1440 RPM, whose 60/24=2.5-frame nominal interval needs the ceiling rule to reach 20.0/s) — pullsPerSec 2.4 is therefore the clean quantized value, not a fitted one. Over 10s = 24 pulls × 92.5% × landing fraction of final ATK before crit/buffs. SKILL1 (Tilted Scale → burst-window crit): self Critical Rate 75% for 10s on burstCast. The literal kit is a STACK RAMP — 'on firing the last bullet: Tilted Scale Critical Rate ▲0.75% continuously, stacks up to 100 times; Tilted Scale stacks ▲29' (i.e. +29 stacks = +21.75% crit per last-bullet fire, capping at 100 stacks = +75%), 'removed when Full Burst ends'. The engine has NO '+N stacks per trigger' primitive (buff apply is +1 stack/trigger, src/engine/sim.ts:1922) and NO Full-Burst-end buff-REMOVAL primitive, so the literal sawtooth (build over ~4 last-bullet fires ≈ 33s, wipe at FB end, rebuild) cannot be encoded. The LOAD-BEARING observable is K's crit rate DURING her burst window (the dominant damage source): at steady state she reaches the 100-stack cap (=75%) well before each burst cast (4 last-bullet fires × ~8.15s magazine cycle ≈ 33s < 40s CD), so 'burstCast self critRatePct 75% for 10s' is the faithful steady-state burst-window magnitude. The pre-burst-phase crit (on her modest 9.1%/pull SMG output) and the first-burst ramp (first cast lands before the cap) are under-credited — documented ⚑ below. SKILL2 (Fulfillment of Righteousness): all allies maxAmmoPct ▼51.13% + Attack Damage ▲10.62% for 10s, triggered on lastBullet. The kit trigger is 'when gaining Tilted Scale'; Tilted Scale is ONLY gained on firing the last bullet (skill1), so lastBullet is an EXACT proxy for the trigger (not an approximation). The 10s duration from a ~8.15s-cadence last-bullet fire gives near-continuous team uptime, matching the kit (the buff persists until FB end and is immediately re-applied on the next last bullet). 'Similar effects cannot be stacked' is satisfied by the engine's same-caster buff refresh/overwrite semantics. UNMODELED (honest residuals): (S1c) 'when pellets land a critical hit 4 times → 23.9% of final ATK as additional damage to the target' — the engine has NO crit-GATED hit counter at all (hitCount fires every N cumulative HITS, not every N CRITS; src/skills/types.ts TriggerDef), so a hitCount:4 proxy would count non-crits and fire on the wrong condition. Magnitude is secondary (~5% of burst-window damage at steady-state crit rate). (S1d/S2c) 'when Full Burst ends: removes Tilted Scale / removes Fulfillment of Righteousness' — no FB-end buff-removal primitive; moot for S2 (10s duration self-expires ≈ the FB window) and folded into the burstCast-10s Tilted Scale encoding for S1. Kit-autonomy gauntlet 2026-08-02.

caveats: burst: the swap weapon's exact shot SHAPE is a KIT-TEXT-LITERAL assumption, not datamine-confirmed — her swap weapon has no `shot_detail` record in data/characters.json (only the human-readable description plus the raw `skill_value_data[0]` percent field, 5466 → 54.66% at level 1, scaling to 92.5 at max). 'Pelletcount: 10' is therefore read literally as ONE muzzle firing a 10-pellet spread, matching the shape of every other implemented SG unit; a multi-muzzle decomposition would land the same total damage but a different per-pellet basis. ⚑

burst: pullsPerSec 2.4 = the swap weapon's nominal 144 RPM (10% of the base SMG's datamined 1440 RPM rate_of_fire, per 'Attack speed ▼90%') run through the engine's existing frame-quantization formula (`quantizeToFrames`, sim.ts:224 — already MEASURED/validated 2026-07-23 against real footage for the general mechanism); 60/2.4 = 25 is an exact frame count so quantization is a no-op, unlike the base SMG's own non-integral 1440 RPM. Owner-confirmed reading: the kit's percentage modifies the swap weapon's own nominal rate directly, not the base SMG's already-frame-quantized 20.0/s effective rate. ⚑

burst: because the swap declares weapon 'SG', her burst shots also take SG range-band eligibility (RANGE_ELIGIBLE near = SG, so she GAINS the +30% range bonus in the near band and LOSES it in mid, where her base SMG had it) and SG auto-core banding (acrForHR keys off the swap class), both via the existing swap-class routing (sim.ts effWeapon). Her swap shots' burst-gauge feed is also wired through the same pellet-landing fraction as the damage (shotGauge(u, frame, sgGaugeFrac)); in practice this is inert for her because the full-burst gauge lock means she generates no gauge at all during her own burst window (verified: her gauge event log is identical with and without this routing). It would become live for any future SG-swap that fires outside a full burst. ⚑
